Real shared goods need not increase output; identical output need not preserve living relations. Wider life classification and basic conflicts remain scoped open. No new theorem or empirical study; earlier ethical learning and comparison results are retained.

**新内容怎样取得伦理分量 / Warrant for new ethical content，2026-10-08。** [伦理学习 §§8–11](unified-2026-10-05/ETHICAL-LEARNING.md#living-realization-and-normative-significance)将实际生活、其支承关系与进一步形成相连，给出新内容、共同善及组织替代的具体根据。/ Shared understanding can matter without more output; a carrier’s unchanged output does not certify preservation of that relationship. [Argument and author counterreview](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ETHICAL-LEARNING-INTEGRATION.md#living-realization-continuation) retain G0/J scope, genuine losses and unresolved wider classification. No new mathematical or empirical claim.

entry_before.title_zh: 生成性对齐：当前首要方向之一
entry_before.title_en: Generative alignment: a current primary direction
entry_before.claim_zh: 以生生为共同根据评价目标、评价者与选择规则；方向论证及相连目标取得、判断、实际修订与有界改革现已成为完成成果，更强理论按明确范围继续。 后续接通改革自身改变实际负担及报告路线、直接取得与保留新目的的修复。 理论接续区分发现已有根据、形成新生活与理由、修订评价承诺；学习后的赞同不独自认证形成过程。 在已完成的伦理学习基础上，新增比较接口辨明理由内容扩展后旧判断的传递、不可比及有前提的反转。 评价扩展进一步区分共同改善与各应用分别否定；旧内容保持不要求旧评价永久保持。
entry_before.claim_en: Appraise ends, evaluators and selection rules through shared generative grounds; the direction argument and connected acquisition, judgment, operative revision and bounded reform are now completed foundations for the broader programme. A further joined case connects reform-induced burdens and reporting changes to acquired correction and repair preserving the new goal. The theoretical continuation distinguishes discovering existing grounds, forming new living relations and reasons, and revising normative commitments; later endorsement alone does not authorize the formation process. Building on the completed ethical-learning account, a new comparison interface delimits preservation, incomparability and conditional reversal after warranted content extension. Evaluative extension further separates a common improvement from defeat in each live application; retained old content need not preserve every old verdict.
entry_before.scope_zh: 当前首要方向之一；方向论证及本轮相连机制均已独立验收，不再作为待做接口。新相连结果：27新定理／84新声明审计、46继承审计，13历史／221完整状态；规范采用、对应、权限、有限资金与现实部署范围分明。 本会话后续另增23项定理／43项审计，93项继承定理／165项审计分列；此后续为同作者反审，无新经验验证或独立agent验收。 新增有辩护的伦理学习哲学候选，采用G0/J及已有认识承诺；作者反审，无新数学、经验或独立验收。 理论续研另增8项泛型定理／9项空依赖新审计，继承实践30项／46审计；保留开放发现、意义辨认及实际动机的未完成范围。 理论接续另增20项定理／36项审计，直接导入同期关切扩展；38项继承定理／55项审计分列。实际应用覆盖及规范分类仍是前提，不宣称普遍决策规则或经验新验证。
entry_before.scope_en: A current primary direction. The direction argument and new connected mechanism are independently accepted, not unfinished interfaces. New connection: 27 theorems/84 new and 46 inherited declaration audits, 13 histories/221 full states, with normative adoption, correspondence, authority, finite funding and deployment scope explicit. This session adds a separate 23-theorem/43-audit followup, with 93 inherited theorems/165 audits separately credited; author counterreview, no new empirical or independent-agent acceptance. Adds a defended ethical-learning candidate under G0/J and inherited epistemic commitments; author counterreview, no new mathematics, empirical study or independent acceptance. A theoretical continuation adds eight generic theorems/nine axiom-free new declaration audits, separately retaining 30 inherited practical theorems/46 audits; open discovery, warranted recognition and actual motivation remain scoped unfinished connections. A theoretical continuation adds 20 theorems/36 audits and directly imports concurrent concern extension; 38 inherited theorems/55 audits are separate. Actual coverage and normative classification remain premises, without a universal decision rule or new empirical validation.

entry_before.connection_zh: 目标形成—后果使用—有根据的操作目的修订—选择安排改革—有限接续已条件性完成；更大的现实形成与部署问题保持独立范围，不重复此接口。 新前沿：在不预送正确读取路线和修复方案时，取得遗漏后果、选择有能力承担的回应。 伦理学习的概念连接已给出；新生的意义范围、未定基本冲突及实际可靠形成分别保留论证负担。 本轮已辨明内容扩展的比较条件；接续研究区别的取得、规范相关性及实际关切形成，正面生成也可成为入口。 理论前沿：在不给定正确答案的情况下，取得新关系的区别并论证候选描述及基本／次级分类的根据。
entry_before.connection_en: Acquired ends, consequential use, warranted operative revision, allocation reform and finite continuation are conditionally complete; broader real-world formation and deployment retain separate scope. New frontier: acquire omitted consequences and select an affordable response without being handed the correct access route and repair. The conceptual ethical-learning connection is now articulated; unfamiliar living significance, unresolved basic conflicts and reliable actual formation retain distinct burdens. Comparison under extended content is now delimited; investigate acquisition, normative relevance and operative concern, including positive formation as an entry point. Theoretical frontier: acquire distinctions about new relations and warrant the candidate descriptions and basic/secondary classifications without supplying the correct answer.
